Pad Kra Pao Gai · Thai Basil Chicken

Fiery holy basil stir-fry over jasmine rice with a crispy fried egg.

Ingredients
• 450 g chicken thigh, minced
• 30 ml oyster sauce
• 15 ml fish sauce
• 1 tsp sugar
• 6 garlic cloves
• 4 Thai chilies
• 30 g holy basil leaves
• 2 eggs

Steps
1. Pound 6 garlic cloves and 4 Thai chilies into a coarse paste.
2. Fry the eggs in hot oil until crisp at the edges, about 2 minutes, then set aside.
3. Stir-fry the paste for 30 seconds, add 450 g chicken thigh, minced and cook 3-4 minutes.
4. Season with 30 ml oyster sauce, 15 ml fish sauce and 1 tsp sugar. Fold in 30 g holy basil leaves until wilted.

Notes
Holy basil (kra pao) is not Thai sweet basil.
